fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has released the notification for the post of Group 4 Stenographer. This recruitment has been issued for 861 posts. Online applying process for MPESB Group 4 Stenographer Recruitment 2025 will start from 04 February 2025 & the candidates can apply till18 February 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for MPESB Group 4 Stenographer Recruitment 2025 which has given below. 

Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB)

MPESB Group 4 Stenographer Recruitment 2025

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 04 February 2025
  • Last Date : 18 February 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 18 February 2025
  • Exam Date : 30 March 2025
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Category : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, OBC : Rs. 250/-
  • EWS / PH (Divyang) : Rs. 250/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 20/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

[adinserter block=”3″]

MPESB Group 4 Notification 2025 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 01 January 2024
  • Minimum Age : 18 Years
  • Maximum Age : 40 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per RRC ECR Apprentice Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

MPESB Group 4 Stenographer 2025 : Vacancy Details

Total Posts : 861 Posts

Post Name Total Post
Group 4 (Assistant Grade-III, Steno Typist, Stenographer, etc.) 861 Posts

MPESB Group 4 Bharti 2025 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates must have passed Higher Secondary (10+2) and hold a 1-year computer diploma/certificate.
  • Candidates Must clear MP CPCT with Hindi typing at 20 WPM and/or English typing at 30 WPM as required.
  • For Hindi Stenographer, shorthand speed of 100 WPM from a recognized body is required.
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.

MPESB Group 4 Online Form 2025 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://esb.mp.gov.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the MPESB before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other Sarkari Result 2025 Notification Here – Check Now.
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for MPESB Group 4 recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.

MPESB Group 4 Recruitment 2025 : Mode of Selection

  • Written Exam
  • Skill Test (If Applicable)
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination
